linejam.name: Linejam
linejam.pitch: Write one line, seeing only the line before it. After nine rounds, everyone reads the whole poems aloud.

kindred.name: Kindred
kindred.pitch: When exactly two of you say the same thing, you both score. Three of a kind scores nothing.

double-take.name: Double Take
double-take.pitch: Everyone gets the same two worlds. Write the one line that fits both best.
